name: Cobra Mk III (placeholder hull)
comment: Snapshot of the geometry baked into rtl/render/Renderer.scala (shipVerts + the ring-derived shipFaces). Live source of truth is the Scala literal at elaboration time; this JSON exists so the geometry is visible/diffable from outside the HDL, and as a future readmemh source if Renderer is ever refactored to load ROMs at runtime. tools/oracle/blueprint.py verifies JSON and HDL stay in sync.
